title: Adaptive on-call timelapse export and anomaly snippets for faster triage
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: On-call responders spend time opening multiple dashboards and correlating signals. This PR introduces a compact, exportable 'timelapse' artifact that packages a focused sequence of telemetry deltas (metrics, short span excerpts, and representative logs) plus auto-extracted anomaly snippets to make triage faster and shareable with runbook authors.

What this PR does (single-string summary): Adds a server-side timelapse generator, an anomaly-snippet extractor that identifies short windows of unusual activity, a small UI flow (export modal) and CLI integration (sloctl timelapse export). The output is a zipped JSON+attachments bundle with a small manifest and optional sanitized samples.

Design highlights: - Timelapse = sampled metric series deltas (percentiles + histograms), span head/tail snippets (N=3 per service), and up to 30 short log lines bounded by size. - Anomaly-snippet extractor uses a lightweight two-stage heuristic: score candidates with rolling z-score over configurable windows, then validate with a change-point detector tuned for our telemetry shapes. This yields short windows (~30s-3m) that are included verbatim (with optional redaction). - Privacy/scrubbing: sensitive fields are scrubbed by default using the existing redaction ruleset; customers with Private installs can toggle full-raw export behind KMS-protected keys. - Performance: exporter streams slices and writes compressed chunks to GCS-compatible archive store; generation is CPU-bound for trace parsing so we parallelize per-service shard. - Rollout: feature-flagged, canary to 5% of orgs for 48h, then 25% for a week; metrics instrumented for generation latency, size, and abort rate.

Usage examples embedded in the UI and CLI: sloctl timelapse export --incident=INC-2026-42 --since=15m --format=zip  (returns URL)

Testing and QA: added unit tests for the scoring heuristics, integration test that generates a synthetic incident and validates the bundle manifests, and an end-to-end smoke that the UI modal triggers the export job and downloads a file under feature-flag. CI: initial run had a flaky e2e; rerun passed.

Security review notes: redaction rules applied by default; storage TTL is 7 days for hosted and configurable for Dedicated/Private. Audit log entry created per export job.

Migration/compatibility: no breaking API changes. Timelapse is additive and behind a feature flag.

Context and related work: complements incident snapshots (incident-bot) by providing compact, timeline-focused artifacts intended for rapid human triage and offline sharing; ties into runbook templating work (ENG-1498) so authors can pin the timelapse as evidence for regressions.

Requested reviewers: see list above. Checklist: - [x] server exporter - [x] anomaly snippet extractor - [x] CLI wiring - [x] UI modal + download - [x] tests + docs - [x] feature flag + rollout plan

Implementation details (high level commits included below) and a tiny illustrative snippet from the CLI plumbing: 

  // sloctl timelapse invocation (pseudo-go)
  err := client.TimelapseExport(ctx, &timelapse.Request{IncidentID: "INC-2026-42", Window: "15m"})

End of description.
commits: 4 commits: 1) Add timelapse exporter service and API endpoint; 2) Implement anomaly-snippet extractor + heuristics; 3) UI: timelapse export modal, status poller, download handler; 4) CLI + docs + tests.
review_comments:
Ethan McCoy: Nice approach. Two asks: 1) make sure export size has an upper bound per-tenant (avoid DOS), 2) ensure redaction handles nested JSON in logs.

Priya Shah: Added per-tenant size cap (configurable) and extended redactor to handle nested objects; included tests.

Lena Fischer: The change point detector looks promising, but we should avoid heavy false positives on percentile spikes during deploys. Can we add a simple deploy-silence window?

Priya Shah: Added a 2-minute deploy-suppression window keyed off deploy events (if available) and fallback to a median-rate check when no deploy metadata is present.

Daniel Park: CI flaky e2e on the first run (CI/selenium timeout). Re-run passed. Please add a retry wrapper to the e2e runner.

Priya Shah: Wrapped the flaky step with a 2x retry and logging; also added test-label to exclude from fast presubmit.
Security review (L3): Confirmed redaction + audit logging behavior; flagged KMS toggle docs for Private installs.
release_notes:
- Add 'Timelapse' export for incidents: compact telemetry bundles for fast offline triage.
- Auto-extracted anomaly snippets included by default (configurable).
- CLI support: sloctl timelapse export.
- Feature-flagged rollout and per-tenant size caps to prevent abuse.
notes_on_rollout: Feature flag default=false for hosted; canary to 5% orgs for 48h, monitor generation_latency and avg_archive_size; escalate if abort_rate > 5% or generation_latency_p95 > 30s.
qa_summary: Unit tests added for z-score and change-point detector. Integration test validates bundle manifest and sample redaction. E2E smoke verifies UI flow; initial flaky e2e addressed by retry. CI green on final run.
